marketAlerts.msg: Second refresh of 02 Sep. Gemini is now FULLY REFRESHED - the Maersk typeahead opened this time, the routings-queries POST was captured and replayed across 28 lanes, and all four of TP11, TP12, TP15 and TP16 cover w36-w43 from live data. The plain Haiphong geoId returns HTTP 422 on every lane, so Haiphong is now queried through the Lach Huyen deepwater geoId 086LJZA1UAYWF, which returns the TP11 calls cleanly. Only TP15 Ningbo carried forward - that lane under-returns from Maersk, as documented.

Premier Alliance only partly refreshed. The ONE Route Finder served three lanes - Shanghai to Savannah, Shanghai to Houston and Yantian to Houston - and then returned the high-volume modal on Ningbo to Houston and stayed throttled. Four service-port pairs are fresh (EC1 Shanghai, EC2 Shanghai, EC4 Shanghai, EC4 Yantian) and 21 are carried forward from the last good pull: EC1 Kaohsiung Yantian Ningbo Busan, EC2 Singapore Cai Mep Yantian Busan Laem Chabang, all eight EC3 ports, and EC4 Cai Mep Kaohsiung Ningbo Busan. Correction to the previous run note - localStorage does NOT get cleared on ecomm.one-line.com navigation, so lane results now accumulate safely.

Ocean Alliance carried forward unchanged from the 02 Sep morning rebuild - 268 cells, all seven services covering w36-w43 with no empty ports. The CMA routing-finder quota was deliberately left unspent so it stays available for the next run.
ZIM EMPIRE, AMERICA and LONE STAR re-derived from data.json as required. 98 in-window sailings, zero gaps against the tracker. AMBERJACK and EMERALD carried forward from this mornings MSC pull.

WHL+HPL AA7 refreshed from the Wan Hai long-term CSV on the first fetch of the session - 18 sailings, rotation unchanged. Transit times re-derived as per-vessel medians, Shanghai to New York 42 days which matches the PRAGUE EXPRESS reference.

EXTRA LOADER AA9 fully verified from the Wan Hai CSV. WAN HAI 712 voyage E002, 7,092 TEU, Ningbo departing 03 Sep and Qingdao 06 Sep, routing via Balboa to New York 11 Oct, Norfolk 14 Oct, Charleston 16 Oct and Savannah 18 Oct. Ningbo to New York is 40 days, level with the AA7 proforma.

EXTRA LOADER XL still running. MAERSK MONTANA voyage 639E, 4,544 TEU, Yantian 23 Sep and Busan 28 Sep, arriving Houston 31 Oct. Yantian to Houston is 38 days against the TP15 proforma of 34, so it is four days slower than the regular Gulf string.

Flexport Atlas responded normally this run after failing entirely this morning. 23 vessels checked: 13 newly added to the TEU cache (the HMM and Yang Ming ships that had no figure at all), 7 confirmed unchanged, none changed. Tacoma Maersk has no Atlas page. The CMA CGM T. JEFFERSON and T. ROOSEVELT slugs did not resolve, so both keep their cached figures and their previous asOf dates.

Proforma ages are incomplete. TP11, TP12, TP15, TP16 and ZIM AMERICA, LONE STAR and EMPIRE all carry a proforma with no asOf date, so their age cannot be judged. They were not re-pulled this run because the scraping budget went to the two alliances that failed this morning. Next run should re-pull the Maersk and ZIM proformas first.

MS2 confirmed absent from the profile. The ONE Shanghai to Houston and Yantian to Houston pulls returned 8 MS2 rows between them and all were dropped at parse time as required. No service additions, terminations or rotation changes detected this run.
